MAPC_CO_BF.description: Enables multiple coordinated APs to adjust spatial beamforming nulls to minimize inter-BSS co-channel interference.

test_cases.title: Coordinated Sounding Frame Parsing & Master-AP Synchronization
test_cases.steps:
1. Configure Master AP and Slave AP in MAPC cluster.
2. Inject Sounding Trigger Frame.
3. Capture Sounding Feedback from client STAs across BSSIDs.
test_cases.expected: Slave AP correctly interprets Master AP Trigger Frame; Compressed Beamforming Matrix (NDP) correctly reported without corruption.

test_cases.title: Inter-BSS Interference Nulling & Throughput Gain Under Edge SNR
test_cases.steps:
1. Position STA at BSS overlap boundary.
2. Enable Co-BF between AP1 and AP2.
3. Run simultaneous TCP DL streams on both APs.
test_cases.expected: Aggregate throughput increases by >= 25% compared to uncoordinated transmission due to beam nulling.

test_cases.title: 48-Hour Continuous Multi-AP Sounding Matrix Drift Test
test_cases.steps:
1. Run continuous bi-directional UDP traffic across 4 coordinated APs for 48 hours.
2. Periodically trigger CSI updates every 100ms.
test_cases.expected: Zero beamforming matrix desynchronization or AP memory leaks observed over 48 hours.

test_cases.title: Maximum Coordinated Client Density Null Steering Queue Limit
test_cases.steps:
1. Associate 128 client MLDs across 3 Co-BF APs.
2. Trigger simultaneous Co-BF sounding requests under 90% airtime utilization.
test_cases.expected: AP management queues process sounding frames gracefully without dropping control frames.

test_cases.title: Minimum Coordinated Channel Sounding Interval Limit
test_cases.steps:
1. Set Co-BF sounding trigger period to minimum standard threshold (e.g., 2ms).
2. Inject Doppler phase noise.
test_cases.expected: AP caps sounding overhead cleanly and maintains PHY rate stability.

test_cases.title: Co-BF Interoperability with Dynamic Subchannel Operation (DSO)
test_cases.steps:
1. Enable Co-BF between AP1 and AP2.
2. Trigger dynamic subchannel allocation on 80MHz secondary sub-band during active beamforming.
test_cases.expected: Nulling matrices dynamically adjust to newly allocated DSO subchannels without packet corruption.

NPCA.description: Allows STAs/APs to dynamically transmit on clear secondary channels when the primary channel is occupied by interference.

test_cases.title: Dynamic Secondary Channel Switching Signaling Validation
test_cases.steps:
1. Inject continuous carrier energy on Primary 20MHz channel.
2. Trigger transmission request on AP.
3. Capture EDCA preamble on Secondary 40/80MHz channel.
test_cases.expected: AP detects primary channel busy state and shifts transmission header to NPCA secondary channel within SIFS.

test_cases.title: 95th Percentile Latency Reduction Under Primary Channel Congestion
test_cases.steps:
1. Saturate primary 20MHz channel with 80% background interference.
2. Measure end-to-end latency for high-priority voice traffic with NPCA enabled vs disabled.
test_cases.expected: NPCA reduces 95th percentile latency by >= 40% under primary channel congestion.

test_cases.title: Rapid Channel Hopping Stability Under Dynamic Radar/Preamble Interference
test_cases.steps: 1. Inject random burst noise on primary and secondary channels every 10ms for 12 hours.
test_cases.expected: AP maintains stable data sessions without restarting MAC firmware or dropping client associations.

test_cases.title: Max Client NPCA Switching Requests Under Heavy Uplink Load
test_cases.steps:
1. Connect 64 STAs with NPCA enabled.
2. Simulate primary channel block and trigger simultaneous UL transmissions.
test_cases.expected: AP contention engine routes all 64 STAs to available secondary channels without CCA deadlock.

test_cases.title: NPCA Switching SIFS Timing Threshold Compliance
test_cases.steps: 1. Measure physical delay between primary channel Busy detection and preamble start on secondary channel.
test_cases.expected: Switching time strict compliance within standard defined SIFS tolerance (+/- 1us).

test_cases.title: NPCA Coexistence with Multi-Link Operation (MLO) Link Steering
test_cases.steps:
1. Setup 2.4GHz + 5GHz + 6GHz MLD connection.
2. Block primary channel on 5GHz link during active NPCA transmission.
test_cases.expected: MLO traffic steering coordinates with NPCA to failover to 6GHz link without packet loss.

SMD_ROAMING.description: Provides unified context transfer across AP MLDs to ensure seamless roaming with zero packet loss.

test_cases.title: SMD Key and Sequence Number Context Transfer Validation
test_cases.steps:
1. Associate Client MLD to AP-MLD 1 in SMD group.
2. Trigger roam to AP-MLD 2.
3. Verify context transfer frame exchange over inter-AP backbone.
test_cases.expected: AP-MLD 2 receives PMKSA, frame sequence numbers, and TID state without full 802.11 re-association exchange.

test_cases.title: Zero-Packet-Drop Roaming Latency (< 5ms) for Real-Time Video/Voice
test_cases.steps:
1. Stream 4K video (50 Mbps) to client MLD while moving attenuator from AP1 to AP2.
2. Measure roaming handoff gap.
test_cases.expected: Handoff gap strictly < 5ms with zero dropped audio/video frames.

test_cases.title: Continuous Ping-Pong Roaming Soak Between 3 Coordinated APs
test_cases.steps: 1. Attenuate client signal back and forth between AP1, AP2, and AP3 every 3 seconds for 24 hours.
test_cases.expected: Zero session drops, zero memory leaks in SMD controller cache.

test_cases.title: Simultaneous Mass Client Roaming Handoff in Dense SMD Network
test_cases.steps: 1. Simultaneously trigger 100 client MLD roams from AP1 to AP2.
test_cases.expected: AP2 handles all 100 context imports without dropping existing active connections.

test_cases.title: SMD Context Transfer Expiry Time Limit at Coverage Edge
test_cases.steps:
1. Trigger roam at extreme edge (-88 dBm RSSI).
2. Delay backbone context packet delivery.
test_cases.expected: Client gracefully falls back to fast BSS transition (802.11r) if SMD context timer expires.

test_cases.title: SMD Roaming with Active Target Wake Time (TWT) Power Save
test_cases.steps:
1. Establish negotiated TWT service period on AP1.
2. Trigger SMD roam to AP2 during client TWT sleep state.
test_cases.expected: AP2 inherits client TWT schedule without waking client prematurely.

DSO.description: Allows APs with wider operating bandwidths to dynamically allocate narrow dynamic dynamic subchannels to STAs on a per-TXOP basis.

test_cases.title: Per-TXOP Subchannel Allocation Frame Signaling Validation
test_cases.steps:
1. Associate 20MHz legacy STA to 160MHz AP.
2. Transmit downlink frame using DSO subchannel assignment element.
test_cases.expected: STA correctly decodes assigned dynamic subchannel within 160MHz BSS bandwidth.

test_cases.title: Spectral Efficiency Multiplier in Heterogeneous Bandwidth Networks
test_cases.steps:
1. Connect mix of 20MHz, 40MHz, and 160MHz STAs to single AP.
2. Measure total aggregate cell throughput with DSO enabled vs disabled.
test_cases.expected: DSO increases overall cell spectrum efficiency by >= 30% by packing narrow clients into unused sub-bands.

test_cases.title: Continuous Dynamic Subchannel Re-allocation Soak Test
test_cases.steps: 1. Run dynamic DSO allocation changing subchannels every 10ms across 32 clients for 24 hours.
test_cases.expected: Stable PHY synchronization with zero packet corruption.

test_cases.title: Max Subchannel Allocation Density Under Full Queue Load
test_cases.steps: 1. Trigger simultaneous DSO requests for 16 subchannels on a 320MHz AP link.
test_cases.expected: AP scheduler allocates subchannels without allocation collision or packet queue drops.

test_cases.title: Subchannel Allocation Band Edge Mask Compliance
test_cases.steps:
1. Allocate DSO subchannel directly adjacent to BSS band edge.
2. Measure spectral mask emissions on spectrum analyzer.
test_cases.expected: Adjacent channel power ratio (ACPR) stays within regulatory spectral mask limits.

test_cases.title: DSO Interaction with P-EDCA Real-Time Queue Scheduler
test_cases.steps: 1. Send high-priority voice traffic using P-EDCA over DSO dynamic subchannel.
test_cases.expected: P-EDCA access delay prioritized over regular DSO subchannel scheduling.
